findings.title: No tolerant-read fail-safe IT for a legacy old-type funnel document
findings.issue: Tech-spec Testing Strategy explicitly lists: 'Fail-safe: legacy old-type document, that survived a manual wipe, must not crash the engine on start (tolerant-read).' No test inserts a raw funnel_execution / funnel document with stepType="SEND_MESSAGE" (a now-removed enum constant) and asserts the sweep skips/handles it gracefully instead of throwing on enum deserialization. legacy_linear_run_drains_via_index_fallback covers a no-id legacy SHAPE but NOT an unknown-stepType VALUE.
findings.recommendation: Add FunnelExecutionEngineIT::legacyOldTypeDocument_doesNotCrashEngine: insert via mongoTemplate a raw org.bson.Document funnel_execution whose stepsSnapshot[0].stepType is the string "SEND_MESSAGE" (or "MENU"), run engine.sweep(), and assert the sweep completes without throwing and the row is left untouched / failed gracefully (whichever the tolerant-read contract is). If the production code has NO tolerant-read path and would actually throw on unknown enum, this finding is escalated to MAJOR and the tech-spec claim must be reconciled.

findings.title: StepTypeTest lacks a negative guard that removed types are gone
findings.issue: The task body explicitly calls this out: 'if StepTypeTest is not extended with a guard check on MESSAGE — mark as coverage gap'. It IS extended with messageStep_present, but there is no negative assertion that StepType.valueOf("SEND_MESSAGE")/"SEND_IMAGE"/"MENU" now throws IllegalArgumentException. A future accidental re-add of an old constant would not be caught here (it is only indirectly caught by the exhaustive switches compiling). Acceptance Criterion in tech-spec: 'StepType no longer contains SEND_MESSAGE/SEND_IMAGE/MENU'.
findings.recommendation: Add StepTypeTest::removedTypesAreAbsent asserting assertThatThrownBy(() -> StepType.valueOf("SEND_MESSAGE")).isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class) for each of the three removed constants (and optionally assertThat(StepType.values()).extracting(Enum::name).doesNotContain(...)). Cheap, directly pins the AC.

findings.title: Stale e2e/funnels.spec.ts references removed composer UI (MENU/SEND_MESSAGE selectors)
findings.issue: funnels_menuGoldenPath_buildAndActivate uses selectOption('MENU') and selectors step-text-input / step-menu-text-input; the addSendMessage helper relies on the dialog defaulting to SEND_MESSAGE with step-text-input. None of these exist in the composer UI (the form now uses step-block-text-N / step-composer / MESSAGE only). If run via `pnpm test:e2e` against the live stack it would fail. It is NOT in the vitest CI gate (vitest include = tests/**; e2e runs only via the separate Playwright script with a live :3000 + :8080), so it does not break current CI.
findings.recommendation: ACCEPTABLE TO DEFER for THIS feature: tech-spec deliberately mandates 'E2E: None' for funnels (golden path covered by engine ITs; real delivery via Test-for-me post-deploy). The file is not a required artifact and is not exercised by the gate. However it is now dead/misleading. Recommended: either (a) migrate funnels_menuGoldenPath to the composer UI (selectOption('MESSAGE'), build a TEXT block via step-add-block + step-block-text-0, attach buttons via step-menu-add-button + step-menu-target-N) and rewrite addSendMessage accordingly, or (b) mark the menu/send-message e2e tests test.skip with a comment pointing at the composer migration, to stop them masquerading as live coverage. Not a blocker for feature sign-off.

findings.title: FunnelExecutionEngineIT is @Tag("slow") — gated behind -PrunSlow
findings.issue: The load-bearing at-most-once + snapshot-isolation ITs live in a @Tag("slow") class (the 5xx-exhausted case incurs the real backoff ladder). If the default CI lane runs without -PrunSlow=true, these critical invariants are NOT exercised on every push.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the CI pipeline runs the slow tag at least on the merge/main lane (decisions.md Wave 2 gate reports a full `./gradlew test` with 1107 tests including the slow class, so it IS run somewhere). No code change; just verify the deploy pipeline includes -PrunSlow on the gate. Informational only.

findings.title: Crash-semantics terminal-write race only proven for terminate(), not complete()/scheduleDelay()
findings.issue: The test itself documents that complete()/scheduleDelay() claim-CAS no-op is 'defense-in-depth verified by code structure' (unreachable under a synchronous race since no I/O precedes them). This is a reasonable, explicitly-reasoned gap, not an omission.
findings.recommendation: Accept as designed. The reasoning is sound (those paths run only with the claim already held, no interleaving I/O). No action.

findings.title: Assertion quality is high — no mock-only / litmus failures found
findings.issue: Spot-checked the anti-patterns the task flagged: verify(...) calls use ArgumentCaptor where arguments matter (album caption-on-first, keyboard on the exact send, callback_data 'exec-1:0'); IT assertions check Mongo state + send counts, not just HTTP status (controller validations assert the $.code business code, not bare 422); preview XSS asserts the raw response body lacks <script>; at-most-once asserts times(K) across two ticks. No empty/true==true tests, no mock-return-then-assert-same-value litmus failures observed.

pyramid_verdict.balance: Correct. Heavy unit base (executor branch logic, sender wire/retry/scrub, copyOf, renderer) with MockWebServer for the sender — no over-mocking (sender unit hits a real HTTP mock, not stubbed RestClient). Integration layer uses REAL Testcontainers Mongo for the two load-bearing invariants (at-most-once, snapshot isolation) — NOT proven on mocks, exactly as the anti-pattern checklist demands. Validation is double-covered: unit (FunnelStepForm.composer client mirror) + controller-IT round-trip — justified because client and server validators are independent code paths that must agree. E2E correctly None per tech-spec. No inversion, no redundant duplication that reduces zero confidence.
